data.subject: Local Ledger: TRC, BRT, FRPH
data.body:
Hi,

Your fund's most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in TRC, BRT, and FRPH.

TRC reported Q2 2026 revenue of $14.3M versus $8.3M a year earlier (+71.7% y/y). (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/96869/000162828026054146/0001628280-26-054146-index.htm)

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records (permits, agendas, call reports, filings), with every claim cited.

Could I send the free weekly issue and discuss a four-week fund pilot? Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
